title: Build session resumption and bounded shutdown
statement: Send the start prompt on a first session and resume the recorded Kiln session afterwards, recovering by presenting available sessions when the record is missing or corrupt rather than resuming an unrelated generic session; stop both trees on Pi exit and on signals with bounded escalation, on Windows and POSIX.
notes: F122 (2026-09-16): CI run 35097288227, at commit b8b09b2, windows-latest node 22, natural mode. The launch preflight timed out on the primed WMI route at 10,009.7 ms with no rows, and the supervisor refused with process-table-not-primed before either Pi or the launcher was spawned. ACC-0081's 10-second preflight bound held as specified, so the criterion outcome stands. This is the second primed-route timeout event that EVD-0109's recorded rule names: WMI is withdrawn as the Windows identity strategy and replaced wholesale by a WMI-free identity format, delivered as a separate correction. The later green run 35141902017 does not cancel it. Interactive session recovery for ACC-0103 is paused until the replacement is green. F130 (2026-09-17, watch item): CI run 35214314607 at commit a957d43, windows-latest node 22, interrupt evidence. One WMI-free identity read for the launcher tree started 5,384 ms into the shutdown with a 2,316 ms allowance and did not answer (process-table-timeout); the other seven Windows reads in that cell took 362 to 530 ms. With 298 ms left no further read was started, the launcher descendant was recorded unverified, and the run refused with shutdown-not-observed at 7,706 of 8,000 ms. The deadline and fail-closed behaviour held. The failed job was not rerun and production shutdown behaviour is unchanged. If another Windows CI run times out on a WMI-free identity read, phase instrumentation of identity reads (spawn, first byte, exit) follows. F130 recurred in the same run on windows-latest node 24: five consecutive WMI-free reads ran to the full 10,000 ms bound (four real-reader tests and the natural evidence preflight, which refused the launch before spawning), while later reads in that cell took 245 to 638 ms. Under the recorded rule, O6 phase instrumentation is active. F133 (2026-09-17, watch item): CI run 35250274939 at commit 3a2a830, windows-latest node 22. The unit test 'a descendant that survives its parent is escalated, and the tree is not reported stopped' reported no surviving descendant where it expected one. It injects its processes but uses real timers (200 ms grace, 150 ms hard wait, a 30 ms parent exit), and the commit under test changed only the guard-file module. Not investigated. If it recurs, that test's real-time dependency is replaced with deterministic clock controls; its waits are not increased. ⚠️ NEEDS CORRECTION, 2026-09-24. ACC-0103 is reopened: the first-run start prompt this task owns was never sent. The correction: send /kiln-start only when the session recorded after locking is new, and send no start message on a resume. ACC-0081's shutdown verdict is unaffected. ⚠️ CORRECTED 2026-09-24 (EVD-0143, commits c46f16d and eb734bc): the start prompt is sent on a new session recorded under the lock, when Pi has a terminal, and never on a resume. F130 RECURRED THREE TIMES ON 2026-09-24 and stays open for a focused shutdown investigation. (1) Diagnostic run 36046760284, job 107792102267: Windows interrupt platform evidence, shutdown-not-observed. (2) Run 36056185119, Windows Node 24: ACC-0116's launch ended with 'Not observed: agent-descendants'. (3) Run 36065687783, Windows Node 24: PLATFORM EVIDENCE (win32, natural), shutdown-not-observed. It is not dismissed as a flake. F130 O1 (2026-09-24, commit ca476de): the trees now stop side by side and one process-table read at a time serves both. CI run 36074014369 at ca476de passed all four cells. The one focused Windows batch was run 36074016941 on the never-merged branch diag/f130-batch: the full suite 8 times, 4 on Node 22 and 4 on Node 24. RESULT: natural-mode platform evidence, the demonstrated cause, passed 8 of 8; it had failed 3 times earlier that day. TWO MECHANISMS REMAIN, and neither is fixed. (1) Interrupt mode, 1 of 8 (job 107881093769): the launcher tree waited 4.2 s for a descendant that did not exit. Its identity read then got 2,225 ms, up from about 1,511 before O1, and needed 2,435 ms to its first byte. The read was abandoned, and the descendant, pid 5700, was STILL ALIVE when the supervisor returned (aliveAtReturn). It was reported launcher-descendants-unverified and not killed. (2) ACC-0116 on the real launcher, 3 of 8: Not observed: agent-descendants. The piped Pi lives for about 1 to 2 seconds, and the Windows tracker samples every 3,000 ms with reads of 0.4 to 2.4 s, so no clean look completes while the agent is alive. This was seen before O1 as well. Both are recorded as limits of this batch; F130 stays open. ⚠️ REOPENED 2026-09-24: ACC-0081 fails on EVD-0146, so the shutdown work is open again. Two mechanisms remain to resolve before ACC-0081's pass is restored or ACC-0088 is completed: (1) a launcher descendant left running after an interrupt when its identity read runs out of deadline; (2) a short-lived agent whose descendants the Windows tracker never observes. ACC-0103's first-prompt pass stands.
